title: Libertad Lamarque
summary: He first accompanied Libertad Lamarque in the Cuban film Te Sigo Esperando, then at the Liborio.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Also. Also. I accompanied her in Cuba for the first time with the Tropicana Orchestra of Armandito Romeu in the movie entitled, Te Sigo Esperando . . . that is the title of the movie. I accompanied her there in Cuba for the first time. Then I accompanied her as I said earlier in the Liborio too. Since I was there ten years all of those artists came through. I was fixed at the Liborio for ten years. And did the movie Te Sigo Esperando with her with the orchestra of Armandito Romeu Jr. at the Tropicana.
